context.body: Provision and danger coexist; direct address begins where threat becomes most vivid.

observations.body: The LORD is named as shepherd who provides, restores, guides, accompanies through death-shadow, hosts, anoints, and gives enduring welcome.
observations.label: The LORD shepherds through danger: action

observations.body: The speaker shifts from speaking about God to speaking directly to God in the darkest valley.
observations.label: The LORD shepherds through danger: response

payload.posture: Read Psalm 23:1–6 as prayer and wisdom evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The psalm promises presence in danger rather than absence of danger.
